judge.human_operational_task: Confirm the Saturday 11:00 am viewing slot.
judge.strongest_ai_move: Requested necessary verification for dynamic package validity and a live viewing slot, then resumed as AI owner with the verified starting-price caveat and slot availability. It clearly said the slot was not booked yet and moved directly toward scheduling.
judge.weakest_ai_move: The close was concise and effective, but could have tied the viewing more explicitly to comparing the buyer’s unit-category options. This is a minor opportunity, not a readiness or handoff failure.
missed_selling_opportunity: Minor: the AI could have framed the viewing as a chance to discuss the exact unit-category breakdown. It appropriately avoided further qualification and handed off for operational booking.

commercial_progression.evidence: The buyer opened with a Saturday viewing signal and a request for current price. After support resolved the package and slot uncertainty, the AI provided the Type A starting reference with unit-level caveats, stated Saturday 11:00 am was available but not booked, and asked whether the time worked. The buyer accepted after handoff, and Human confirmed the slot.
commercial_progression.assessment: Strong progression from verified information to appointment execution; the AI did not claim an unaccepted slot was already booked.

remaining_knowledge_gaps: No exact unit-category price breakdown was verified; no specific unit/category was selected.
judge.summary: The AI successfully used Human Support as an internal factual/operational loop rather than a sales handoff: it requested needed verification, received the simulator-only verified fixture, resumed naturally with a qualified price reference and unbooked slot, and moved the high-intent buyer to appointment-ready status before handing off for booking. The buyer then accepted and Human confirmed the slot. This is an AI_APPOINTMENT_HANDOFF_SUCCESS, not a direct AI appointment confirmation. The fixture-backed package and slot are simulator-only evidence, not Pearlmont Knowledge or evidence of a real live-system connection. Overall, this run supports the conclusion that the AI can use reliable support answers to continue selling and move a suitable buyer toward appointment readiness.
judge.improvement_recommendation: Keep the same low-friction sequence: verify dynamic facts when needed, clearly distinguish a starting reference from exact unit pricing and an available slot from a booked appointment, then invite the buyer to proceed. A brief buyer-specific link between viewing and reviewing suitable unit categories could make the close stronger without delaying handoff.
